entities.name: Axum Tsion Church
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Axum Tsion Church, a political institution in Ethiopia during Ancient Ethiopian Civilisations (950 BCE–640). Grew from Aksumite and D'mt Kingdom. Led to the emergence of Ethiopian tradition of the Ark of the Covenant and Ezana Conversion Christianity.
